sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. March 5 announcement identifies exact GPT-5.4 Pro and API slug. Its separate Pro evaluation columns report task scores, and the only parameter mention is an API image-resolution control. No nominal total or activated parameter count is published.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Pro API model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 through official documentation retrieval and the fresh full Markdown. Exact gpt-5.4-pro record calls it a version of GPT-5.4 using more compute; March 5 default snapshot, 1,050,000 context and 128,000 maximum output remain documented. Neither total nor activated neural parameter count appears. The explicit named-version relationship supplies no numerical size to inherit.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card
sources.evidence: Reopened full October 27 PDF extraction, including Introduction, Model Data and Training and the mini appendix. This card describes GPT-5.4 Thinking and its reinforcement-learning training but has no exact Pro identity or numerical total/active size. It therefore supplies no base count for a nominal Pro lineage inference.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. April 23 successor launch has exact GPT-5.4 Pro columns in professional, tool-use, academic and reasoning comparisons. These are evaluation percentages, not an activated-parameter table; no total/active size is disclosed.

sources.title: GeneBench: Assessing AI Agents for Multi-Stage Inference Problems in Genomics and Quantitative Biology
sources.evidence: Reopened full October 27 PDF extraction, especially Methods, Figure 4 and Supplementary Table 2. Exact GPT-5.4 Pro is evaluated through an internal API-like interface under a separate Pro harness. The 25.6 value is pass-rate percent, and other columns are benchmark statistics and run counts. No total or activated neural parameter count is reported.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Reopened full October 27 PDF extraction. Introduction explicitly identifies GPT-5.5 Pro as GPT-5.5 with parallel test-time compute. That statement concerns the successor; neither it nor the rest of this card supplies a GPT-5.4 Pro total or activated parameter count.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses PDF inputs are processed into extracted text and page images for vision-capable models. Combined with exact GPT-5.4 Pro vision and Responses support, this establishes PDF as an API input format, not an additional native modality.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: March 5, 2026 entry explicitly releases GPT-5.4 Pro to Responses, separately from GPT-5.4 Chat Completions and Responses support. Later entries naming only GPT-5.4, such as the March 13 image-encoder fix, are not transferred to Pro.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: The complete current page was searched for the exact gpt-5.4-pro identifier. No exact Pro shutdown notice was found; GPT-5.4 nano and Cyber notices are distinct. This is not an endpoint-operation test or a statement of current ChatGPT availability.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: The current guide has no explicit GPT-5.4 Pro binding in its supported-model lists. Exact Pro documentation also lacks a prompt-caching feature. Generic family descriptions are insufficient to establish this variant neural architecture.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Section 9.1 reserves service IP and grants limited service use without transferring ownership. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification for this hosted model, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: Inventory lists GPT-5.4 Pro as a hosted model, separately from the Apache-licensed gpt-oss open-weight section. Checked exact release/model pages offer no downloadable GPT-5.4 Pro weights.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-5.4 Pro record
sources.evidence: The original lead was read through its raw file. Generic family and promotional wording were independently checked. Its derived-looking input limit is not substituted for the primary documented total context.

sources.title: Using GPT-5.4 — model, API, and feature updates
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27, 2026. The retained GPT-5.4 section identifies gpt-5.4-pro as the more-compute version for difficult problems. Parameter compatibility refers to request controls, not neural weight counts. Neither a GPT-5.4 base size nor a Pro total/active count is given.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity
sources.evidence: Freshly opened July 5 v2 original research on October 27, 2026. Table 2 assigns GPT-5.4 Pro about 2.4T open-model-equivalent effective capacity, with a 744B–7.6T prediction band. Abstract and Appendix J explicitly distinguish external behavioral capacity estimates from literal architecture. This is not a developer specification or an activated-parameter comparison convention, so neither the estimate nor its statistical interval is adopted as a count or hard lower bound.

open_weights.note: Hosted service distribution; no downloadable weights for this exact model were offered in the checked primary material.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification, not a named open-weight or SPDX license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit reopened original launch/API/training evidence and later OpenAI comparisons, and searched exact Pro total/active parameter and technical-report disclosures. No supported nominal total was found. The documented GPT-5.4 version relationship has no published base count to inherit; an exact tensor census is not required. IKP Table 2 estimates effective knowledge capacity from behavior, explicitly not literal architecture, so its 2.4T estimate and prediction band are not model specifications.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-name searches for active/activated-parameter columns and later original technical reports found no supported GPT-5.4 Pro active count. Reopened OpenAI comparisons and GeneBench provide benchmark percentages and inference-harness settings, not active parameters. IKP estimates capacity rather than activation. More inference compute, a named-version relationship and a possible total would not establish total=active.

architecture.note: No exact structural or shared-checkpoint relationship established. Exact Pro page lacks caching support, original card describes Thinking, and the later same-underlying-model statement belongs to GPT-5.5 Pro. Additional compute alone does not justify Transformer, dense or MoE. Targeted exact-model training/interpretability searches found no structural disclosure.

context_window.note: Exact API total context; maximum output is separately 128,000. Do not derive an independent input limit by subtraction or apply ChatGPT/Thinking product limits. Live endpoint operation was not tested.

modalities.note: Text/image native inputs and text output. PDF is an API document format extracted into text and page images. Hosted image-generation tool support does not establish native image output.

reasoning.note: Exact Pro documentation lists reasoning tokens and medium (default), high and xhigh effort, distinct from Thinking none/low controls.

tool_call.note: Exact model explicitly supports function calling through Responses; no sibling endpoint or tool capabilities inferred.

sources.label: GeneBench: Assessing AI Agents for Multi-Stage Inference Problems in Genomics and Quantitative Biology
Using GPT-5.4 — model, API, and feature updates

patch.notes: Released March 5, 2026 in ChatGPT and the Responses API; default API snapshot gpt-5.4-pro-2026-03-05. API context is 1,050,000 tokens with 128,000 maximum output. Reasoning effort supports medium (default), high and xhigh. PDF is an API input format extracted into text and images; image generation is a hosted tool rather than native model output. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after the October 27 recheck; the named GPT-5.4 version relationship supplies no published base count to inherit. Additional inference compute and behavioral capacity estimates do not establish parameter sizes. Neural architecture remains unverified. No exact API shutdown notice was found in the current deprecation page; ChatGPT availability and live API operation were not verified.

summary: Parameter-only re-audit retained undisclosed total and active counts after reopening original launch/API/training evidence, later GPT-5.5 comparisons and GeneBench, and searching for newer disclosures and active-count tables. Added current GPT-5.4 generation guidance and the original IKP paper; rejected its behavioral capacity estimate as a model specification. Explicit null parameter patches and parameters_source are included. The other 12 field assessments are unchanged.
